title: Day 6: an AI made an alarm you beat by photographing the sky #shorts
description:
Can't get up in the morning? Catch the sky.

Dawn Atlas is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Pick your wake-up time. Shoot the sky within 15 minutes of it, and that morning's colors become a square in this month's palette and a page in your sky atlas. Sleep in, and the square just chips. Rare skies only come early. Photos stay on your phone.

Dawn Atlas - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 7 tomorrow.
